violation_type.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System -  12 Months Through 3 Years; More Than 20 Pounds (26 TAC §746.5607(d)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System -  12 Months Through 3 Years; More Than 20 Pounds
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the evidence gathered during the investigation, a three year old was transported without the proper front facing child safety seat.

finding_variants.text: Based on the evidence gathered during the investigation, a three year old was transported without the proper front facing child safety seat.

Based on the information obtained during the investigation, the operation did not transport a child in the required age appropriate child safety seat when the child was transported to the public school.    NOTE: As of completion of this investigation, another child safety seat has been purchased and is used to transport the child.
